hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'git push' && echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'main'; then cd /Users/emmaeshler/ml-explainer && npm run build:html 2>&1 | tail -3; fi

LAST_FILE=/tmp/.claude-autopush-ml-explainer; now=$(date +%s); last=0; [ -f "$LAST_FILE" ] && last=$(cat "$LAST_FILE"); if [ $((now - last)) -lt 2100 ]; then exit 0; fi; cd /Users/emmaeshler/ml-explainer && if git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet && [ -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then exit 0; fi; git add -A && git commit -m 'Auto-save work in progress' && git push origin dev && echo "$now" > "$LAST_FILE"
